entry.title: Gentle care when the car seat is needed
entry.summary: The authors call car seats essential for safety, even though seats limit a baby’s movement. They describe telling the baby what is happening and using gentle hands during this necessary care.
entry.cue: You are preparing to place your baby in a car seat.
detail: The book suggests attending to hunger and a needed diaper change before the trip. It treats being placed in the seat as something the adult can explain to the baby.
Participation grows with what the baby can do. The authors give offering an arm as one possibility, while the adult remains responsible for the care.

references.locator: Essential restraint, gentle explanation and participation appropriate to the baby

ageContext.readiness: Any participation follows what your baby can do; the adult provides the necessary care.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
